# 🎼 Plan, explore, review, commit

A full delivery pipeline: a planner and an orchestrator drive architect, researcher, explorer, implementer, QA strategy, security, code review and docs subagents through small test-first phases, with a review and a user-approved commit after each. Pick it for multi-phase feature or refactoring work; for analysis and planning only, use orchestration-basics.

Install: `plan-explore-review-commit@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

## Start the pack

| Tool | How |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub Copilot | Pick **Orchestrator Agent** in the agent dropdown and describe the job. It hands off to the other agents. |
| Claude Code | Run `/plan-explore-review-commit` followed by the job. The command coordinates; the agents below do the work. |
| OpenAI Codex | Copy [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into `.codex/agents/`, then run `$plan-explore-review-commit` followed by the job. |

Claude Code and Codex agents cannot start other agents, so there the orchestrator is a command that runs in your conversation.

## Agents

| Agent | Name in Claude Code and Codex | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Orchestrator Agent** (orchestrator) | `/plan-explore-review-commit` command | Drives a plan, implement, review and commit lifecycle across specialist subagents, one small test-first phase at a time, with stop gates before each commit. Use for multi-phase feature or refactoring work that should be planned, reviewed and committed in reviewable steps. |
| Architect Subagent | `perc-architect` / `perc_architect` | Evaluates architecture options for a decision, with trade-offs, NFR impact, a light threat model and test implications, in ADR-ready form. Use when the Orchestrator Agent or Planner Agent faces a design decision with real alternatives. |
| Code Review Subagent | `perc-code-reviewer` / `perc_code_reviewer` | Reviews a phase's changed files for correctness, regressions, security, and test quality, and returns APPROVED, NEEDS_REVISION or FAILED with tiered issues; never edits. Use after each implementation phase, before the commit gate. |
| Docs Writer Subagent | `perc-docs-writer` / `perc_docs_writer` | Writes README sections, usage examples, API docs and release notes from the shipped change set. Use at closeout of a plan, or whenever user-facing behaviour or an API changed. |
| Explorer Subagent | `perc-explorer` / `perc_explorer` | Maps files, usages, patterns and entry points read-only and breadth-first, and returns a structured file list with findings. Use as the first discovery step before research, planning or implementation. |
| Implementer Subagent | `perc-implementer` / `perc_implementer` | Implements exactly one plan phase test-first with a minimal diff, runs the project's tests, linter and type-checker, and reports back with a proposed commit message; never commits. Use for each implementation phase of the plan, followed by the Code Review Subagent. |
| Planner Agent | `perc-planner` / `perc_planner` | Writes a research-driven, test-first phased plan with NFRs, risks and acceptance criteria into the plan directory, ready for the Orchestrator Agent to execute. Use when a feature or refactoring needs a plan before any code is written. |
| QA Strategy Subagent | `perc-qa-strategist` / `perc_qa_strategist` | Designs a risk-based test strategy for a change: test levels, coverage map, quality gates and flakiness mitigation. Use when the test approach for a phase or plan is non-trivial. |
| Researcher Subagent | `perc-researcher` / `perc_researcher` | Researches a subsystem in depth and returns its conventions, key files, patterns, prior art and risks as structured findings, without planning or coding. Use after exploration when a plan or phase needs deeper context. |
| Security Auditor Subagent | `perc-security-auditor` / `perc_security_auditor` | Reviews a change for security risk with a light threat model, OWASP mapping and concrete mitigations; never edits. Use as a quality gate when a phase touches auth, input handling, secrets, dependencies or data exposure. |

How the pack works, step by step: [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md).
